intent: Converge the Foshan open-data 3D viewer into a complete, resilient and honestly-described v1.0 product that works without paid photogrammetry by default.
constraints: Default use requires no paid API key.
Real geographic data and visual estimation remain distinguishable in UI and documentation.
No unlicensed landmark meshes are bundled.
No Overpass/OSM extrusion fallback replaces Overture as the default building path.
Production startup uses lockfile-pinned local bundles rather than runtime CDN import maps.
nonGoals: Claiming generated facade details are surveyed real-world facade details.
Redistributing Google Earth photogrammetry or other proprietary mesh data.
Bundling multi-gigabyte national height datasets in the repository.

requirements.statement: The zero-key default path loads Overture buildings, Terrarium terrain and open satellite imagery by viewport.
Building height sources are prioritized and surfaced truthfully, with optional local open-height overlay support.
Buildings use complete Overture z14 footprints; near buildings add categorized PBR facades, roof attributes and deterministic visual detail without Math.random.
Tile loading has bounded concurrency, retry, stale-view handling and bounded cache eviction.
The viewer provides adaptive quality, landmark flight, building inspection, shareable view state, day lighting and responsive UI.
Production builds use package-lock.json with npm ci and bundle pinned Three.js and tile-decoding dependencies locally.
First-view readiness is progressive and is reported only after at least one real Foshan Overture building has been generated, after which the full view expands in the background.

checks.description: Static, geo, height, roof, DOM, policy, lockfile and bundling-contract tests pass.
Pinned public data endpoints and real Foshan Overture decoding/Three.js geometry path pass.
CI production-browser smoke reaches appReady=true with buildingStats > 0 and produces screenshot evidence.
